user.title: SwitchBot Lock Speed
user.description: Choose a SwitchBot Lock Ultra already set up in the SwitchBot integration (its address and encryption key are reused), or enter the details manually. A test read is done before saving.

manual.title: Lock details
manual.description: Only the SwitchBot Lock Ultra is supported. The key ID and encryption key are the same as for the official SwitchBot integration.

error.cannot_connect: Test read failed ({error}). Make sure the lock is in range and the SwitchBot app is closed, then try again.
error.invalid_key_id: Key ID must be 2 hex characters.
error.invalid_key: Encryption key must be 32 hex characters.
